catalog.name: Planck PSZ2 SZ cluster catalogue
catalog.target_rows: confirmed/catalogued SZ sources with finite sky coordinates and finite redshift
catalog.mass_field: use published M500 proxy if present only as secondary metadata
catalog.reason: all-sky gravitationally selected massive-cluster tracer; independent of low-l CMB morphology construction

cosmology.distance: flat-LCDM line-of-sight comoving distance from catalog redshift

primary_statistic.name: D_NN
primary_statistic.definition: minimum 3D Euclidean comoving distance from either antipodal candidate point to any eligible PSZ2 cluster

primary_null.name: fixed-latitude longitude rotation
primary_null.rule: hold |b|=68.5117419161366 deg and radius fixed; draw unoriented axis longitude uniformly; include both antipodes; recompute D_NN against the unchanged catalog
primary_null.reason: preserves the candidate Galactic latitude and therefore reduces sensitivity to the Planck Galactic selection mask

secondary_outputs: published M500 proxy and its catalog percentile if available

epistemic_boundary.positive_result: mass-tracer coincidence only; not proof of a black-hole/horizon source
epistemic_boundary.negative_result: does not falsify the algebra because the physical locus bridges remain conditional and need not correspond to a PSZ2 cluster

forbidden: apply a post-hoc redshift or mass cut
expand angular/radial window to include an attractive cluster
choose only one antipodal branch after inspection
interpret nearest cluster as the source without an independent mechanism
